messages:
Ava (CEO): Quick Friday flash: a few updates and asks before EOD.
Ava (CEO): Highlights: hosting revenue +8% since last week; trial activation rate for Dedicated up 22%. Nice work.
Ava (CEO): Infra: global p95 now 170ms after kernel rollout; still seeing a spike in ap-southeast during peak (Raj, pls note).
Raj (CTO): Confirmed. We traced the ap-southeast spike to a degraded network path from partner DC. SRE applied a routing hotfix; monitoring shows recovery but we'll keep watch for 24h.
Noor (Head of Research): The model quantization we piloted reduced memory by ~35% with minimal quality delta on our eval set. Recommending trial for low-latency endpoints.
Maya (VP Product): Product asks: Burst Capacity beta docs ready. Need final pricing bands and customer-facing copy by Mon noon. Link: https://redwood.ai/internal/burst-beta
Ben (CFO): Financial note: if burst pricing is too aggressive it will affect margin on high-throughput customers. Let's use the tiered approach we discussed.
Jared (Head of Eng): Ops note: canary runbook updated with KV cache warmup and cross-region fallback tests. I'll schedule a dry-run Mon 10:00 UTC.
Lina (Head, CS): CS will prepare pilot onboarding email + two onboarding sessions next Wed/Thu. Also drafting an FAQ about data retention changes.
Ava (CEO): Policy change: default log retention moves to 90 days for new tenants (existing tenants default stays at 180 unless they opt in). Compliance ok'd. Please escalate any customer concerns.
Ben (CFO): We should notify enterprise contracts team; some contracts reference retention defaults. @Lina please triage.
Raj (CTO): Action item for SRE: export p95 by region for last 72h and share before Monday exec. If any region >250ms, we hold canary.
Jared (Head of Eng): Acknowledged. Adding system tests to confirm fallback when a region's p95 crosses threshold.
Maya (VP Product): Marketing sync: Lina, can you coordinate a single release note and a short 'what's new' blurb for customers?
Lina (Head, CS): Yep. Draft by Mon 09:00.
OpsBot: Release window scheduled: 2026-03-30 02:00-03:00 UTC. Smoke tests configured.
Ava (CEO): Final ask: bring any blockers to Monday exec review. Thanks team, resting on good momentum.
Jared (Head of Eng): :white_check_mark:
Noor (Head of Research): :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Lina (Head, CS): :email:
